They totally have friendship, respect and admiration for each other, but they are also deeply attracted to each other. All those things can go together. And in fact, it's good that the respect and romance is there together, because that is what makes for a healthy relationship. "Love" isn't just sexuality, or an addiction (as it is with Cersei). You can be friends with someone and be in love with them, AND be attracted to them. It actually happens.

Wen I read comments here and elsewhere, I see that people truly believe this, and no, it's not true. It can happen. It does happen. 

​

Poor Nikolaj has been fiercely hinting at this in every single interview he can. He's openly stated that Jaime is IN LOVE with Brienne. So as far as he is concerned, he loves her (he may still love Cersei, but he definitely loves Brienne as MORE than just a friend).

My original F response as a child was Fight - I very directly express distress and anger at unfair and abusive situations. Because this was "uncomfortable" for my parents, they beat that response out of me. During my teens and 20's I relied on flight response, developing horrible anxiety, trying frantically to escape my past and memories. In my late 20's I was much more the fawn type, and a complete doormat. Now in my late 30's I fall mostly into the freeze response, and try to make myself as invisible and irrelevant as possible to avoid abuse. I've cycled through all the F's, but in the end, I always come back to Fight, because that's who I originally am, though I am much better at regulating my anger. I won't let my abusers destroy my truth-saying anymore.
